units.spine: The town does neither well nor badly. The road is in use and the market is held, and nothing here is being built and nothing sold off.

units.poolKey: INCOME MIX: two or three sources between them
units.spine: Asked what the town lives on, the people of the town name a short list of trades rather than one trade.

units.poolKey: TRADE PROFILE: exports and imports both present
units.spine: The market carries the town's own goods and goods brought in from elsewhere on the same stalls. Nothing marks which is which.
Something is always going out of the town. When one trade goes quiet, another does not.
Spitzplatz is not hungry and has nothing put by, and a shock to the fields or the road would be felt inside a season.
Caravaneer's post stands, and the supply it depends on has failed further off. The building is kept and the skill is kept, and no goods come in.

Unlicensed trade goes on here and nothing is organised behind it… the odd part, in a town with a market and a road through it. What holds it small is nowhere written down, and whoever reads this next would do well to find out.
